supersession_rules.rule_1: A run is SUPERSEDED when a subsequent run for the same family+wave exists with the same or expanded scenario set.
supersession_rules.rule_2: Only the AUTHORITATIVE run's artifacts are valid for PR publishing. Superseded run artifacts must not be submitted as PRs.
supersession_rules.rule_3: A run may be PARTIALLY_AUTHORITATIVE if it contains the only passing artifact for a specific scenario and the subsequent runs did not re-run that scenario.
supersession_rules.rule_4: Historical superseded runs are preserved in workspace/runs/ as audit evidence — they are not deleted.
